about_the_game:
Kaiten is a roguelike tactical-strategy game. Spin the wheel with various move opportunities and develop your strategy based on the results. Build your deck with special perk cards purchased from the shop between sessions and empower your pawns! Achieve victory to unlock new rage abilities and opponents.

Your pawns are your warriors on this battlefield, but they are only as strong as the perks you equip them with. Create a collection of powerful perk cards and devise devastating combinations that can change the course of battle.

SPIN THE WHEEL

Each turn begins with the spinning of the wheel that determines your move. Will you land on a devastating attack, a powerful item, or a special move that will change the course of the game?

COMMAND YOUR PAWNS

Lead your pawn lineup in tactical combat. Each pawn can attack the enemy across from it, but choose your targets wisely - your decisions could make the difference between victory and defeat!

BUILD YOUR DECK!

Each perk grants your pawns unique abilities and bonuses. Increase your defensive, offensive, or economic power. Grow stronger and win the battle!

WIN

Win 3 out of 5 sessions to emerge victorious! But remember! If all your pawns die, you lose completely.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
